title: Interop Rollout — Python Tools variants canonical package export + channelized publish parity
description: Track the plugin-side work needed for the python-tools variant family to participate cleanly in the canonical plugin package interop model, including variant semantics and channelized publish behavior.
design:
Package family facts:
- Package root: /Users/sarav/Downloads/side/rzn/pysandbox-rs
- Variant ids: python-tools, python-tools-system, python-tools-ds
- Current shipping shape: signed Rzn bundles with one MCP stdio worker each and no bundled skills, hooks, or app manifests
- Variant semantics matter and must stay explicit: bundled minimal runtime, system-python-only, and bundled data-science runtime
- Packaged resources/examples center around python_sandbox metadata and examples
- Existing publisher automation already supports channelized release via stable, beta, and nightly
- Shared release contract: /Users/sarav/Downloads/side/rzn/rznapp/docs/specs/PLUGIN_RELEASE_CHANNELS_AND_PUBLISH_CONTRACT_V1.md
- Aligned host rollout issue: rznapp-ifx.22

Implementation expectations:
- Preserve distinct package identity for each variant instead of flattening the family into one ambiguous package
- Make variant/runtime semantics explicit in exported interface metadata and publisher docs
- Keep tool-provider-heavy shape honest: no synthetic Skills or Hooks unless they are actually added later
- Align release scripts and docs with the shared local-first then cloud channel publish contract
acceptance_criteria:
A clear plugin-side interop plan exists for the python-tools variant family, with variant semantics and release-channel behavior captured explicitly.
Plugin owners can implement canonical export and publish updates without rereading the original design thread.
The issue body points directly at the shared release contract and aligned host-side rollout issue.
